## About Me

Professor Lian has been actively researching supply chain finance, leverage adjustment, trade credit, innovation, and related topics in empirical corporate finance. He teaches Financial Econometrics and Applied Econometrics.

His teaching has been recognized by consecutive perfect evaluations in the MBA corporate finance course over three years, and he received the title of *My Favorite Teacher* in 2022 from Lingnan College.

He has also made substantial contributions to the [Stata](https://www.stata.com/) community through widely used packages such as `winsor2`, `xtbalance`, `bdiff`, and `sftt`. He is one of the initiators of the Chinese Stata Users Group Meeting and has delivered invited keynote talks in [2018](https://www.stata.com/meeting/china18/), [2020](https://www.stata.com/meeting/china20-Uone-Tech/), [2021](https://www.stata.com/meeting/china21-Uone-Tech/), [2022](https://www.stata.com/meeting/china22-Uone-Tech/), and [2023](https://www.stata.com/meeting/china23-Uone-Tech/).

## Research Areas

- Causal inference and applied econometrics
- Stochastic frontier analysis and efficiency measurement
- Supply chain finance, trade credit, and capital structure
- Stata-based empirical workflow design and reproducible research

## Teaching

- Financial Econometrics
- Applied Econometrics
- MBA Corporate Finance
